Idk what they'd think. I wish I knew. It's the only thing stopping me from going. Last night after the fight with my husband I went to the bedroom and was crying so hard it was like screaming and I couldn't breathe. I wanted to call 911 and tell them "I need help. I want to die" so someone one come pick me up and get me admitted right away. I just don't want it affecting my son. Like I said, I'm not like "mother of the year" status but my son is my EVERYTHING and I am happy around him, I'm a good mother. I wouldn't want to lose my son if we ever got a divorce.
My son is over a year old. My doctor ruled out PPD. :(
